name: ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI's AI assistant for chat, images, research and coding.
description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's AI assistant for writing, questions, image creation, deep research, file analysis and coding (via Codex), on web, desktop and mobile; the official URL is now chatgpt.com. It is the most widely used general AI assistant. The Free plan includes unlimited everyday chats with GPT-6; paid tiers are Go, Plus and Pro, plus Business and Enterprise plans for organisations.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: The Free plan includes unlimited everyday chats with GPT-6; paid tiers are Go, Plus and Pro, plus Business and Enterprise plans for organisations.

features: Multimodal Input: Understands text, images, and voice commands.
Code Interpreter: Performs data analysis, calculations, and file transformations.
Memory: Remembers user preferences and past interactions (selectively).
Advanced Reasoning: Excels at logic, problem-solving, and creative writing tasks.

howToUse.title: Go to ChatGPT
howToUse.description: Sign in or sign up on ChatGPT's website.

howToUse.title: Start a New Chat
howToUse.description: Type your question, prompt, or task for writing, editing, or brainstorming.

howToUse.title: Use Advanced Tools
howToUse.description: Leverage code interpreter, data analysis, and image input features.

howToUse.title: Save or Share Output
howToUse.description: Copy, export, or continue chats for future use.
